name: lang-csharp
description: Use when the user asks about C# on .NET 10, async/await, LINQ, nullable reference types, Span<T>, records, pattern matching, IDisposable, xUnit or the dotnet CLI. Produces idiomatic, allocation-aware C# and project setup. Not for ASP.NET Core architecture (use dotnet-architecture), Unity scripting (use unity) or MAUI apps (use mobile-dotnet-maui).
